# @yuhere/js-jsonrpc2

Index for coding agents. Read these, in order:

- AGENTS.md — hard constraints
- SKILL.md — how to register methods, transports, streams, permissions, and common mistakes
- README.md — install, schemas, Express / WebSocket / stdio, llm.tools, web client

README sections:

- Deviations from JSON-RPC 2.0
- Schemas, including object strictness and nullable
- Describing parameters with `.describe()` (shown in methodSignature / WebUI / llm.tools)
- Streaming returns
- llm.tools (param0, param1, … and format)
- Web client (timeout, httpCallOptions, AbortSignal)
- Permission checks
- Common mistakes
- Error codes
